verdict.rationale: FreeAgent ships its own background automations: customised automated invoices and reminders, emailed payment reminders and thank-you messages toggled per invoice, and smart categorisation that explains new transactions automatically. These are fixed, feature-specific automations rather than a general facility for users to define their own autonomous workflows. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation or rules builder, trigger and schedule controls, AI-agent-driven autonomous actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Save time by creating customised, automated invoices and reminders.
`true` to email payment reminders if the invoice goes unpaid, `false` otherwise
Save time with smart categorisation which automatically explains new transactions based on previous descriptions.
